title: British defeat the French on the Plains of Abraham
summary: James Wolfe's British army climbed the cliffs above the St. Lawrence and defeated Montcalm's French force outside Quebec City. Both commanders were mortally wounded.
reason: Britain sought to conquer New France during the Seven Years' War, and Quebec was its key fortress.
significance: It led to the fall of Quebec and the end of French rule in Canada.
